request.initial_prompt: I felt an inexpressible relief, a soothing conviction of protection and security, when I knew that there was a stranger in the room, an individual not belonging to Gateshead, and not related to Mrs. Reed. Turning from Bessie (though her presence was far less obnoxious to me than that of Abbot, for instance, would have been), I scrutinised the face of the gentleman: I knew him; it was Mr. Lloyd, an apothecary, sometimes called in by Mrs. Reed when the servants were ailing: for herself and the children she employed a physician.

raw_segments.text: I felt an inexpressible relief, a soothing conviction of protection and security, when I knew that
there was a stranger in the room, an individual not belonging to Gateshead, and not related

knew him. It was Mr. Lloyd, an apothecary, sometimes called in by Mrs. Reed when the
